title: Louis Armstrong's 'Laughing Louie' as ahead of its time
summary: The interviewer cites Armstrong's intro to 'Strutting with Some Barbecue'; Barefield adds that 'Laughing Louie' was way ahead of its time.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, Louis played an introduction on "Strutting with Some Barbeque," which has a lot of feeling of be-bop. You know, like the rhythmic contours of the --
Well, what do you think about "Laughing Louie" (PHONETIC)? Do you remember that record? That was one of the things that was way advanced from Louis' time.
I mean, that was way ahead of its time.
I play that for my class all the time.
Then he did "Western-Blues" which is -- but that was more in keeping. But this "Laughing Louie" was really way ahead of its time.
